name: Camp Afro Foli - Full Camp
description:
# Camp Afro Foli Drum and Dance Retreat

\\n

CAMP AFRO FOLI DRUM AND DANCE RETREAT 28-30 JULY 2023

\\n

Grab your tickets now!!

\\n

 Early Bird Tickets available until 14 April 2023 $445.00 includes GST  
\- Includes Friday, Saturday & Sunday  
\- Includes all tuition, accommodation, Performance night.

\\n

**Where**: [Noosa North Shore Retreat](http://www.noosanorthshoreretreat.com.au/)

\\n

**Sleep**: Shared, spacious two bedroom apartment accommodation with kitchen, lounge room and two bathrooms. Approximately 6 people per apartment. Every apartment has its own kitchen.  You will need to bring all your own bedding including sheets, pillow, doona or sleeping bag.  Every effort will be made so that friends or groups will be in apartments together. There are no camping options. The apartments surround a communal area and fenced pool.

\\n

**Eat**: This is a self – catered event. Every apartment has its own kitchen with the basics including gas cook tops and oven. There is an outdoor BBQ area next to the pool with 4 BBQS to cook on. Please bring your own food and there will be a shared BBQ on the Friday night for those who would like too. There is a bistro and bar onsite for meals, snacks and drinks. 

\\n

**Drinks:** You can BYO to this event and there is also an onsite bar and bistro open throughout the camp. Please be respectful and drink responsibly.

\\n

There will be lots of workshops and an artist performance on the Saturday night.

\\n

Three days of movement, fun, cultural workshops and performances, with international artists bringing Africa to the Sunshine Coast.

\\n

Enjoy beautiful beach surroundings, world class talent and be immersed in West African culture with workshops in djembe, dancing, dundun drumming, and dundun dancing. Loads of action to choose from and the promised gift of rhythm for your hands and feet.

\\n

_Terms and Conditions: All Camp Afro Foli Drum and Dance Retreat full camp passes are non-refundable, non-transferable, and cannot be exchanged for classes or services at a later date. Artists may be subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances._
